name: Spinning rod
definition: fishing rod with line guides on the underside, made for use with a spinning reel.
notes: split from Fishing rod (GR_S12); shops list spinning rods apart from casting and fly rods

name: Casting rod (baitcasting rod)
definition: fishing rod with guides on top and a trigger grip, made for use with a baitcasting reel.
notes: split from Fishing rod (GR_S12); shops list casting rods apart from spinning rods

name: Fly rod
definition: long light fishing rod rated by line weight, made to cast a fly line.

name: Backpacking tent
definition: lightweight, compact tent made to be carried on a hike, usually for one to three people.

name: Family tent
definition: large multi-room tent with standing height, made for car camping with a family or group.

name: Bell tent
definition: round canvas tent on a central pole, sold as a glamping or group tent.
notes: split from Tent (GR_S12); Alpkit Roundhouse bell tents

name: Self-inflating sleeping mat
definition: sleeping mat of open-cell foam in an airtight cover that draws in air when the valve is opened.

name: Foam sleeping mat
definition: sleeping mat of closed-cell foam that needs no inflation, rolled or folded.
